decision: No blocking source defect found. The reviewed RGBNT201 pair is eligible for its planned actual native3 gate; this review makes no neural execution, metric improvement, or goal-completion claim.
followup_scope: The two follow-up files were reviewed separately as prepared CPU intake/reduction sources. They do not change the core 3-source/49-reused deployment gate and were not executed.

The loop trains 50 epochs, tracks actual optimizer steps/skips and cumulative coverage, saves mAP-best using strict greater-than for earliest ties, strictly reloads the best and verifies the six reported metrics. The local deployment/intake enforces 5294 total paired updates and 3951/836/836 counts; paired orders imply equal per-control counts.
source_checks.installed_GT_metrics: The normal audit reconstructs installed filenames and identity/camera/scene labels, matches the official split manifest and raw-array metadata, checks train/query identity disjointness, full training coverage and earliest mAP selection, and recounts mAP/mINP/Rank1/5/10/20 using same-ID/same-camera exclusion for RGBNT and same-ID/same-scene for MSVR310. It compares CMC1..50, every query row and identity/camera/scene group. No model output serves as GT.

The prepared CPU analyzer further compares G epoch/step/names/partial-set traces against corresponding closed unit/raw/AP01/AP05 traces, checks equal expert parameter counts and reports all 11 comparisons and 9196 paired query changes; old partial losses remain diagnostic.
source_checks.GPU_and_closed_consumers: The launcher assigns frequency to physical GPU2 and axis to GPU3 with two workers and a native barrier before full50. The GPU helper restricts to 2/3, waits 240 seconds for memory availability, and queries no temperature/power. No reviewed current path reloads a retired F weight. The retirement text reports the two F best files retired and protected references unchanged.
source_checks.storage_and_archive: New own roots must not exist; remote/local free-space checks precede launch/transfer. A single archive worker emits the exact normal-array path, size and SHA; copy_verified verifies the local destination size/SHA before sending its exact ACK. The remote worker checks ACK identity, root containment, size and SHA before unlinking that one raw array. New best weights and text remain; no missing raw is generated by this candidate stage.
source_checks.generated_remote_code: Both deployment f-string programs (source lines 41 and 57) and the prepared intake package/cleanup programs (source lines 30 and 72) were materialized from the current local plan/proof values and parsed/compiled with stdlib only. All four have real LF line breaks and no carriage returns. The programs were not executed.
source_checks.prepared_followup_intake_and_reduction: Intake requires the closed local G session plus remote complete controller, per-run 2647 updates/zero skips/full counts/GT receipts/archive receipt before collecting text only. Local package bytes/SHA and every extracted text file are verified before exact package cleanup. The analyzer reads only closed JSON/CSV/JSONL, validates six metrics/CMC50/groups/selection, loss==full objective consistency, paired orders and query identity alignment; it does not reload F weights or run a network.

nonblocking_notes: SOURCE_ONLY PASS is not actual native or formal acceptance. The all-parameter gradient check is at the third successful native update, not a per-parameter audit of each of the first two updates. The launcher also rejects any native AMP skip.

Zero coefficients remove the partial objective gradient while retaining its images, forward computation, mining, BN updates and second backward. This cannot support a claim about removing all partial-view computation.

The mature E42/F4 evidence covers four paired training batches and selected parameter derivatives. Larger partial gradients establish local dose/direction observations, not negative transfer, an Adam-update effect, or the success of zeroing them.

This deployment starts RGBNT201 only. The generic builder/launcher accepts the other two official datasets with their existing per-dataset configurations, but no new result for them is established here. Missing49, paired multiple seeds, ordinary-control gains and positive collaboration remain future acceptance requirements.

Both new experts use the original50 anchor plus new50 and official benchmark mAP selects earliest best. Comparisons with original DeMo alone have unequal total budgets; comparisons against the closed narrow/unit experts share the extra50 budget.
The follow-up sources are prepared, separately recorded and unexecuted. Their reports correctly distinguish CPU reduction of completed GT receipts from a new independent GT or neural evaluation.
